title: You Yourself Are The Creator. Everything That
summary: The shabad does not leave hukam at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: You Yourself are the Creator. Everything that happens is by Your Doing
lifeApplication: Name one thing already here that you need to stop negotiating with. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: The separated ones meet, and by great good fortune, those suffering in; you Yourself are the Creator. Everything that happens is by Your Doing
source.lifeApplication: Return begins when the later line is allowed to outlast the first rush of feeling.

evidence.coreClaim: The separated ones meet, and by great good fortune, those suffering in; you Yourself are the Creator. Everything that happens is by Your Doing
evidence.turn: Receive the day as given, then answer it with Naam.
